# ANALYSIS: Validate 1-2 DTE weekly options finding

**Filed:** 2026-09-11  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** analysis  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-OOS)

## Hypothesis

The WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate found that buying the same directional signal at 1-2 DTE weekly options (instead of 0DTE) yields a persistent edge of approximately $59-66 per trade with p<=0.045 OOS. We aim to validate this by running an OOS backtest on the last 6 months of SPY 0DTE and weekly-1 data, comparing average trade P&L and win rate to the 0DTE baseline.

## Mechanism

We will use the same directional signal (as defined in the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate) and compare performance at 0DTE vs 1-2 DTE weekly exits, using identical strike (ITM-2) and exit rules (-8%/+30%). The OOS window will be the last 6 months prior to the data cutoff, using real OPRA fills for realism.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per OP-20 disclosure #1).
2. **Sample bias:** The OOS window will be the last 6 months of data; sample size depends on number of signals triggered in that period. Overfit risk is mitigated by using an OOS window separate from the development period used to form the 1-2 DTE hypothesis.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (we have not yet executed the OOS backtest; only Stage-1 BS-synthetic mechanism evidence available).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (the OOS backtest must use real OPRA fills to satisfy OP-20 disclosure #4).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day could be a large adverse move causing max loss per trade; max drawdown could exceed 30% of account if position sizing not respected; blow-up scenario if weekly spreads widen significantly causing slippage to erase edge.
6. **Concentration:** If the edge is concentrated in a few days, top-5 days could represent a large percentage of P&L; we will disclose top5_pct after OOS.

## Pre-merge gate

<what tests need to pass: gym validators, walk-forward, real-fills>
We require: OOS backtest with real OPRA fills on last 6 months, walk-forward ratio >=0.70, real-fills validation on top-3 J days within ±20% of BS-synthetic, and OP-16 edge_capture >=771.

3 / 10 -- We have only mechanism evidence (BS-synthetic) which shows edge_capture 759.21 (below OP-16 floor) and negative wide P&L. No OOS real-fills validation yet.

## Pre-existing leaderboard impact

This analysis validates or refutes the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE candidate's 1-2 DTE finding. If the edge persists, it may support promoting that candidate; if not, it may lead to its rejection. It does not directly conflict with existing leaderboard entries but informs their assessment.
